name: Waru Gaiden ~Akumu no Rush Hour~
original_name: 悪っ外伝 ～悪夢のラッシュアワー～
source:
The legendary mischief master Honda is released from prison. He thinks of finishing with molesting, but he sees a seducing dancer and goes breaking bad. At the same time the railway company hires two new girl staff members - morality countermeasures expert Shinomiya and national idol Hayakawa. Can they pose a challenge to Honda?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-september-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
